dedupe_keys.name: advancing resilience of transportation infrastructure systems to land subsidence ls sea level rise slr and storm surge in coastal areas

description: Advancing Resilience of Transportation Infrastructure Systems to Land Subsidence (LS), Sea-Level Rise (SLR) and Storm Surge in Coastal Areas is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Yi Liu, Morgan State University (morgan.edu). Vulnerability of critical infrastructure, especially the transportation system and high value assets to direct and indirect damage is increasing in the region, as relative SLR, shoreline retreat and the magnitude and frequency of near-shoreline coastal flooding increases. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2497J. Keywords: Land subsidence, sea level rise, transportation system. Published 2018-09-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
